summaries.en: Former President Trump stated there are no planned talks with Iran, emphasized the effectiveness of the blockade against Iran in the Strait of Hormuz, and posted a map marking the strait as new U.S. territory.
summaries.zh: 前总统特朗普表示，与伊朗没有计划中的对话，并强调霍尔木兹海峡对伊朗的封锁有效，同时发布了一张将该海峡标记为美国新领土的地图。
